summary: Design and generate Barnstormer map files (.map) from a text recipe: terrain, airfields, buildings and cattle, with the placement rules the game enforces but does not document.
use_when: asked to make, generate, design or fix a map, landscape or terrain for Barnstormer or Sopwith
editing a .recipe file, or a .map file that has a .recipe beside it
a generated map fails --check or flytest and has to be diagnosed

tools.name: mapgen
tools.purpose: recipe -> map file, with an elevation profile and lint notes
tools.machine_readable: add --json for a single JSON object on stdout

exit_codes.1: the recipe is wrong, reason on stderr

tools.name: verify
tools.purpose: is it a valid map, and can it be flown out of

exit_codes.2: the game binaries could not be found

tools.name: mapshot
tools.purpose: draw the whole 3000-column world as one picture, in the game's palette and with the game's own building and ox sprites, optionally with the map's name, hash and recipe under it
tools.notes: pure stdlib for svg; png needs rsvg-convert or magick. Stateless and deterministic, so output can be cached on (hash, layout, scale, version). Computes the map hash itself, without the game binary.

exit_codes.3: png was asked for and there is no rasteriser

barnstormer.reason: --check, and the .map header token; earlier builds wrote barnstormer-level

flytest.version: built from the same tree as barnstormer
flytest.reason: the only check that catches an unflyable field

compatibility.note: This skill's version tracks the recipe vocabulary and the generator's behaviour. What ties it to a release is map_format_version and the requires block above, not the game's version number.
